environment.description: Flask application deployed on the same Kubernetes cluster but fronted by an AWS ALB ingress controller with mutual TLS configured at the listener level. The ALB target group uses `proxy_protocol_v2` with TLS client cert attributes propagated. The ALB listener has `MutualAuthentication` set with `Mode: verify`, `TrustStoreArn: arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-ca-store/abc123`, and `IgnoreClientCertificateExpiry: false`. The trust store contains only the internal PKI CA certificate (CN=internal-services.corp.example.com). Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy for the pod restricts ingress exclusively to the ALB security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) on port 8080. The ALB security group itself only allows inbound from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). External clients without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA will receive a 400 error at the ALB layer before any traffic reaches the Flask application.
